description_html: About the role   Adobe Consulting is seeking an experienced Technical Architect to join our team and lead the delivery of next-generation digital experience solutions for enterprise customers.  As the Adobe Experience Cloud ecosystem evolves towards AI-powered and agentic experiences, we are looking for an AEM Architect who combines strong expertise in Adobe Experience Manager with an understanding of emerging AI capabilities and their application to digital experiences.  The role goes beyond traditional AEM architecture. You will work closely with enterprise customers to define technology strategies, modernize digital experience platforms, and adopt emerging solutions such as Adobe Brand Concierge, AEM Co-worker and AI-powered content experiences.  You will act as a trusted technology advisor to customers, lead complex solution architecture and guide multidisciplinary teams to deliver successful outcomes.   What you'll do    AEM and Digital Experience Architecture    Be a recognized technical expert in Adobe Experience Manager, including AEM as a Cloud Service, Edge Delivery Services (EDS), Universal Editor and Document-based Authoring.  Architect scalable, secure and high-performance digital experience solutions across CMS, DAM, personalization and composable architectures.  Guide customers through modernization journeys, including migration from AEM 6.x, on-premise and other CMS platforms to AEM Cloud Service and EDS.  Define architecture and engineering practices that improve performance, Core Web Vitals, scalability and content authoring productivity.  Provide technical leadership across complex enterprise implementations and integrations.    AI and Agentic Experience Adoption    Understand and drive the adoption of emerging Adobe AI and agentic capabilities, including Adobe Brand Concierge, AEM Co-worker and other AI-powered Experience Cloud solutions.  Identify opportunities to leverage Generative AI and Agentic AI to transform digital experiences and content operations.  Architect solutions that integrate AI capabilities with existing AEM platforms, enterprise content, customer data and business systems.  Guide customers on AI-powered content creation, personalization, asset management, content supply chain and workflow automation.  Understand key AI architecture concepts such as LLMs, RAG, agent orchestration, APIs and MCP integrations, and their application in enterprise solutions.  Advise customers on responsible AI adoption, including security, data privacy, governance and brand safety.    Customer and Consulting Leadership    Act as a trusted technology advisor to senior customer stakeholders, including CIOs, CTOs and digital business leaders.  Lead customer workshops, architecture discussions, solution presentations and technology strategy conversations.  Understand customer business challenges and translate them into effective technology solutions and transformation roadmaps.  Shape consulting opportunities by defining solution approaches, contributing to proposals and articulating business value.  Clearly communicate complex technology concepts and the business value of emerging AI capabilities to technical and non-technical audiences.  Build strong relationships with customers, Adobe account teams, partners and product engineering teams.    Technical and Delivery Leadership    Provide end-to-end architectural leadership across large and complex customer engagements.  Lead solution discovery, architecture definition, technical design and implementation oversight.  Work closely with Delivery Managers and Project Managers to ensure successful project execution and customer outcomes.  Lead and mentor architects, developers and multidisciplinary technical teams.  Identify and resolve complex technical challenges and take ownership of architecture decisions.  Develop reusable architecture patterns, accelerators and best practices, particularly around AEM, EDS and AI-enabled solutions.  Stay current with Adobe Experience Cloud innovations and emerging AI technologies and share knowledge across the consulting community.  Manage multiple customer engagements and provide technical leadership with minimal supervision.    What you need to succeed    AEM and Digital Experience Expertise    12+ years of experience in enterprise technology consulting, architecture and software delivery, with strong hands-on experience in Adobe Experience Manager.  Deep understanding of AEM architecture, including AEM as a Cloud Service, implementation, integrations, deployment and performance optimization.  Practical experience or working knowledge of Edge Delivery Services, including block development, Document-based Authoring, Universal Editor and modern front-end practices.  Experience with enterprise CMS, headless/hybrid CMS, DAM, composable architectures and digital experience platforms.  Strong understanding of AEM Assets, content management, workflows, metadata and enterprise integrations.  Familiarity with AEM Cloud Service tooling, Cloud Manager, CI/CD pipelines, Git workflows and Adobe App Builder.    AI and Agentic Capabilities    Good understanding of Generative AI and Agentic AI and their applications in digital experience platforms.  Awareness of Adobe's emerging AI capabilities, including Brand Concierge, AEM Co-worker, Firefly, GenStudio and LLM Optimizer.  Understanding of how AI agents can integrate with enterprise content, applications and business workflows.  Working knowledge of LLMs, RAG, agent orchestration, APIs, MCP and prompt engineering.  Ability to identify relevant customer use cases and architect solutions leveraging AI capabilities.  Understanding of responsible AI principles, including security, privacy, governance, IP and brand safety.    Technical and Architecture Skills    Strong knowledge of Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS and modern web technologies.  Working knowledge of Python and APIs, microservices and enterprise integrations.  Understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP.  Knowledge of cloud-native architecture, Docker, Kubernetes, CDN and edge delivery.  Strong understanding of enterprise architecture principles, including scalability, security, performance, capacity planning and infrastructure.  Experience with Agile methodologies, DevOps and the complete enterprise software development lifecycle.    Customer and Leadership Skills    Proven experience leading enterprise consulting engagements and interacting with senior customer stakeholders.  Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.  Ability to independently lead customer workshops, architecture reviews and executive presentations.  Strong consulting mindset with the ability to understand business challenges and recommend appropriate technology solutions.  Ability to articulate technology solutions and their business value to both technical and non-technical audiences.  Experience leading and mentoring large, distributed and cross-functional teams.  Ability to work independently, manage multiple engagements and take ownership of customer outcomes.  Willingness to work onsite with customers when required and travel up to 50% on average.    About Adobe   Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.   Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.     Let’s Adobe together   At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. title: Senior Cybersecurity Engineer - Enterprise Security Engineering
description_html: Your work days are brighter here.    We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.    About the Team   The Enterprise Security Engineering team is the frontline of Workday's enterprise defense, ensuring that our global corporate environment remains secure, resilient, and ready to support the pace of innovation across the company. We sit at the intersection of endpoint infrastructure, developer enablement, and security automation — protecting Workday's corporate fleet while empowering our engineering community to build and ship with confidence.   Our work spans endpoint privilege management, endpoint detection and response (EDR), SaaS security posture management (SSPM), and the governance of developer tools and emerging AI technologies. In the year ahead, the team will focus on expanding agentic automation pipelines, evolving our application control frameworks to support safe AI adoption, and deepening cross-pillar integration between endpoint, SaaS posture, and threat detection systems.  What makes this team special is our commitment to engineering excellence and to each other. We invest deeply in mentorship and talent development, helping engineers at every level grow their technical depth and take ownership of their domains. If you enjoy solving meaningful security challenges alongside a collaborative, forward-thinking group, this team is for you.   About the Role    As a Senior Cybersecurity Engineer on the Enterprise Security Engineering team, you will bridge strategic architecture and operational delivery. You will take ownership of detection telemetry, SaaS configuration drift, and asset-control gap verification, while providing high-touch escalation support and technical guidance to associate and mid-level engineers.    Key Responsibilities:     Partner with Principal engineers to support endpoint least-privilege policies, publisher allow-listing controls, and application governance workflows across macOS and Windows fleets. Serve as an escalation point for complex application definition triage and advanced exception reviews.  Develop engineering oversight, sensor health monitoring, and detection tuning across our enterprise EDR estate. Build and maintain automated detection and containment response workflows, partnering with internal teams to triage complex endpoint telemetry.  Support the operational posture and policy configuration baseline across our SSPM environment. Identify, investigate, and remediate SaaS configuration drift, privileged account anomalies, and integration risks across critical enterprise SaaS services.  Drive asset governance, device coverage validation, and security control gap identification through Cyber Asset Attack Surface Management (CAASM). Build queries, automated dashboards, and correlation alerts to ensure full agent coverage and policy compliance across corporate assets.  Implement and maintain runtime guardrails and least-privilege boundaries for developer AI tools, coding assistants, and open-source dependencies. Partner with architecture leads to monitor and evaluate the security posture of AI agents and IDE integrations across developer endpoints.  Use agentic evaluation pipelines and automation workflows to streamline intake triage, exception processing, and routine telemetry reviews. Build API-driven integrations that feed endpoint, SaaS posture, and asset signals into central automation and threat-containment pipelines.  Collaborate closely with and mentor associate and mid-level engineers, sharing best practices around script automation, detection engineering, and incident triage. Author clear technical runbooks, architecture diagrams, and operational playbooks to elevate overall team delivery standards.     About You     Basic Qualifications     7+ years of hands-on cybersecurity engineering experience in enterprise environments, with demonstrated success operating at a senior technical level    Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, or a related discipline  At least one recognized credential such as CISSP, a GIAC certification (e.g., GSEC, GCED, GCIA, GCIH, or GDSA), CompTIA Security+, or an equivalent vendor-recognized credential  Hands-on experience engineering, administering, or deploying enterprise tooling across at least two of the following domains: Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR), SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM), Cyber Asset Attack Surface Management (CAASM), or Endpoint Privilege Management (EPM) / Application Control  Working knowledge of macOS and Windows operating system internals, execution controls, and enterprise scripting proficiency (Python, PowerShell, Bash, or Go) with REST API experience  Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex security telemetry into actionable guidance for cross-functional partners          Other Qualifications     Experienced in attack surface analysis, with the ability to understand system architecture, identify potential entry points, and assess the impact of different types of threats to reduce overall organizational vulnerability    Skilled in security engineering practices, including designing and implementing systems, protocols, and procedures that protect information and data from unauthorized access or damage. Experience conducting security audits and developing incident response plans is valued.    Proficient with security platforms, including configuring, operating, and managing security software, hardware, and services across an enterprise environment. Familiar with the latest cybersecurity defense strategies and how to apply them operationally.    Knowledgeable in threat and vulnerability management, with a proactive approach to identifying, assessing, and mitigating potential risks and weaknesses in security infrastructure. Experienced in conducting vulnerability assessments and staying current with the evolving threat landscape.    Experienced in security operations, including the identification, analysis, and mitigation of threats to enterprise information assets. Comfortable developing and implementing security policies, managing security incidents, and guiding teams on best practices.    Proficient in one or more programming languages with the ability to design, write, test, and debug code for automation, process improvement, and API integration across security tooling  Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining operational responsibilities, and a genuine interest in mentoring and developing fellow engineers       Workday Pay Transparency Statement (For EU Locations Only)    Listed below is the base salary range applicable to this position. Workday pay ranges (and the precise pay offered to the successful candidate) are based on a number of objective criteria such as relevant experience and skills, and educational qualifications, level of responsibility, demands of the role, work location and business need. As a part of the total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the Workday Bonus Plan or a role-specific commission/bonus, as well as annual refresh stock grants awarded by Workday Inc. For more information regarding Workday’s comprehensive benefits, please    click here   .    Additional Location Base Pay Range: €84,000 EUR - €126,000 EUR Ireland   Additional Location Base Pay Range: €84,000 EUR - €126,000 EUR Ireland     Our Approach to Flexible Work     With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply  spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field  with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter. description_html: The Enterprise Network Support and SRE team is looking to add a seasoned Technical SRE lead to help actualize the SRE vision for our network infrastructure. We are looking for an engineer who is passionate about the network and making its operation seamless with a focus on user experience. This role will offer several opportunities to solve problems by being hands-on with troubleshooting, focused on network automation, observability, documentation, and excellence in operations. This Network SRE will be dedicated to enhancing network operations, diligently working to minimize manual labor and achieve Service Level Objectives (SLOs) amongst many goals. Our approach includes minimizing reactive operational tasks, documenting KB articles that can be used by Bots, following through on RCAs, conducting blameless postmortems, and proactively identifying and mitigating network risks to foster continuous improvement.    This crucial role will be focused on user satisfaction and brilliance in Network Operations. This SRE engineer will focus on tackling significant projects and is committed to fostering a supportive atmosphere that offers the mentorship necessary for professional development and growth. They will bring a wealth of skills and experience to be a sought after mentor, who leads by example.     What you'll be doing:     Owning the operational aspect of the network infrastructure, ensuring its high availability and reliability.    Partnering with architecture and deployment teams to guarantee that new implementations are supportable and align with production standards.    Advocating for and implementing automation to reduce toil and enhance operational efficiency.    Monitoring network performance, identifying areas for improvement, and coordinating with relevant teams to execute enhancements.    Collaborating with SMEs to resolve production issues swiftly and effectively, maintaining customer satisfaction.    Identifying opportunities for operational improvements and partnering with teams to develop solutions that drive excellence and sustainability in network operations.      What we need to see:     BS degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.    8+ years of industry experience in network site reliability engineering, network automation, network operations, or related areas. Experience on both campus and data center networks.    Familiarity with network management tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Alert Manager, Nautobot/Netbox, BigPanda    Expertise in automating networks using frameworks such as Salt, Ansible, or similar.    In depth experience in one or more of the following: Python, Go.    Knowledge in network technologies such as TCP/UDP, IPv4/IPv6, Wireless, BGP, VPN, L2 switching, , Firewalls, Load Balancers, EVPN, VxLAN, Segment Routing. Proven track record in network operations.    Skills with ServiceNow and Jira    Knowledge of Linux system fundamentals is a plus.    Systematic problem-solving approach, coupled with excellent communication skills and a sense of ownership and drive.      Ways to stand out from the crowd:     Track record of taking operational signals through means such as SNMP, Syslog, Streaming Telemetry to solve operational challenges    History of debugging and optimizing code; automating routine tasks.    Experience with Mellanox/Cumulus Linux, Palo Alto firewalls, Netscalers and F5 load balancers    Previous SRE experience      NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technological world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative, and enjoy having fun, then what are you waiting for? Apply today!    #LI-Hybrid                You will also be eligible for equity and  benefits .           Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 7, 2026.   This posting is for an existing vacancy.   NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.   NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Deep Learning Compiler CI and Infrastructure Engineer
description_html: NVIDIA's invention of the GPU 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. More recently, GPU deep learning ignited modern AI — the next era of computing — with the GPU acting as the brain of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. Today, we are increasingly known as “the AI computing company”.   In this role you will work closely with deep learning compiler engineers to own and evolve the CI/CD infrastructure that powers the development lifecycle of NVIDIA's deep learning compiler stacks. Responsibilities include designing and operating scalable CI systems that orchestrate ML workloads across diverse GPU and accelerator environments, deliver reliable correctness and performance signals, and serve as a primary technical point of contact for CI health, new project onboarding, and new architecture bring-up.    What you'll be doing:    Build, maintain, and improve CI infrastructure that supports development, verification, and release of NVIDIA’s deep learning compiler stacks across GPU and accelerator environments  Improve CI reliability and signal quality by reducing flakes, improving reproducibility, strengthening diagnostics, and making correctness and performance failures easier to understand and act on  Apply automation, AI, and agent-based workflows to reduce manual CI operations, speed up failure triage, and improve developer efficiency  Build reusable and self-service CI platforms that support multiple products, projects, model suites, hardware targets, and software configurations while partnering closely with compiler, infrastructure, and release teams     What we need to see:    BS, MS, or PhD (or equivalent experience) in Computer Science, Computer/Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field  5+ years of experience designing, scaling, and operating CI/CD, build/release, or developer infrastructure for complex software systems  Proven experience building CI platforms end-to-end using systems such as GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar tools, including pipeline orchestration, compute/runner management, artifact and package systems, and observability, with strong emphasis on reliability, reproducibility, and debuggability  Strong software engineering skills (Python required), with the ability to design, implement, and debug distributed systems end-to-end  Familiarity with edge devices (SOC, e.g. NVIDIA Tegra) in host-target architecture, ability to debug it and knowledge to its automation nuances  Proven track record of designing, building, and deploying AI/LLM-based systems in real engineering workflows, demonstrating skill in evaluating trade-offs, failure modes, maintainability, and measurable impact on developer productivity, signal quality, or operational efficiency     Ways to stand out from the crowd:    Experience crafting and shipping sophisticated AI/agent-based systems that improve continuous integration or developer efficiency. These systems include intelligent test selection, automated triage and routing, regression localization, autonomous remediation, and developer-assist workflows  Experience operating CI for DL/GPU software environments, including multi-GPU / multi-node workloads on Slurm, Kubernetes, or cloud platforms  Familiarity with compiler IRs and infrastructure such as LLVM/MLIR, TensorRT IR, especially in the context of testing, debugging, and validating compiler-driven workloads    With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our exclusive engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you.
